remarks: Beautiful pre-war unit with lovely architectural details, including magnificent columns. Crown molding and beautiful hardwood flooring throughout and a soon to be renovated bathroom. With a sleeping area, eating area, three closets, and separate galley kitchen, this cozy abode is one of a kind. The smart layout and high ceilings are truly unique for a studio and provides you with ample space. Heat and hot water included! Multiple complex washing rooms with commercial card-operated washers and dryers. The building includes two beautifully maintained courtyards where you'll find lounge chairs, resident gardening plots, lush greenspace, friendly neighbors, and the occasional bunny. The property is close to stores, restaurants, parks, gyms, and theaters in downtown Stamford. The train station and I95 are both close by.
